item.title: The emotional and mental impact of Valentine's Day
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Friday afternoon, Nurse Practitioner Shantel Marcin discussed the emotional and mental impact of Valentine's Day, especially for those who are feeling lonely or are single.

item.title: Elkhart Police Department receives threats of violence, city says
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The City of Elkhart posted a statement via social media on Friday asking community members to remain calm after the Elkhart Police Department has received several threats of violence.

item.title: Winter’s swinging pendulum
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind.-- The melt continues. With highs reaching the 40s this weekend and 50s next week, melting will increase. These mild temperatures are certainly a change from the bitter cold temperatures Michiana experienced just days ago. While this drastic change seems abnormal, this pattern is not as unusual as many believe.

item.title: ISP investigating Elkhart Community Schools bus driver for possible DUI
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Indiana State Police confirmed to ABC57 that an Elkhart Community Schools bus driver is currently under investigation for possibly driving under the influence.

item.title: Kindergarteners showing appreciation for educators this Valentine's Day
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- Valentine's Day celebrations already getting underway, including at one Benton Harbor school, where kids are showing love for their hardworking teachers.

item.title: Notre Dame fighting for ACC tournament position ahead of matchup with Georgia Tech
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Irish will host Georgia Tech at noon Saturday, but instead of fighting for NCAA tournament positioning, they are battling simply to qualify for the ACC tournament.

item.title: Elkhart residents express outrage following the arrest of local teacher Donald Shafer
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — Elkhart residents expressed their outrage after learning about Elkhart middle school teacher, Donald Shafer, being arrested for child sex crimes.

item.title: Two paramedics honored with the hero award for their life saving work
item.description: CONCORD TOWNSHIP, Ind. -- Two paramedics from the Concord Township Fire Department were honored with the Hero Award from the Michiana Homes for Heros non-profit organization.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash temporarily shuts down east lanes on bypass near Beech Road
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Around 8:09 p.m., reports came in about a two-vehicle crash that temporarily closed down eastbound lanes on Elm Road near Beech Road.

item.title: Michiana gets together for Galentine's Day
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Galentine’s day is unofficially celebrated on February 13th, ahead of Valentine’s Day, ideally a day spent with sisters, mothers and best girl-friends alike.
